text:
Priya Choudhury: FYI ran into a streaming parity/truncation bug across our SDKs when client reconnects quickly. iOS sampleapp repro shows duplicate 'data' events after resume and sometimes missing final.

Alex Martinez: details?

Priya Choudhury: Repro: 1) start sampleapp -> hit /v1/stream 2) simulate 150ms network drop 3) reconnect -> client includes resume header but server processes last chunk twice occasionally, resulting in duplicate tokens. Observed with python backend + mobile EventSource polyfill.

Sasha: iirc some browsers/polyfills add a trailing newline or split the final chunk into two events. Did you capture raw chunks?

Priya Choudhury: yes, captured raw:
```
event: partial
data: {"id":"tkn-789","delta":"hello"

# reconnect
> GET /v1/stream HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.dev.redwood
> Last-Event-ID: tkn-789

# server log shows re-emitting the buffered delta
```

Alex Martinez: maybe our server-side resume logic doesn't dedupe on token id, it assumes id monotonic. If polyfill split a delta across events the id might be processed twice.

Dan L: also check our SSE framing parser for early EOF handling. If client reconnects while we're in middle of parsing, we might flush buffer as a complete event. That could account for duplicate final token.

kevin: which SDKs set both 'Last-Event-ID' + 'last-event-id'? Node sets both, python only sets lowercase. Could be header normalization mismatch in envoy.

Priya Choudhury: confirmed python requests set 'last-event-id'. Envoy lowercases headers when forwarding, our resume check does exact lookup on 'Last-Event-Id' in Go. net/http canonicalizes names but if some filter rewrites it we lose parity.

Sasha: short-term: normalize headers in our router middleware (map any case to canonical Last-Event-ID) and dedupe on event-id in resume logic. Long-term: make SDKs include canonical header and update sampleapps.

Alex Martinez: agree. Also add an e2e: start server, stream a payload where final token is split over TCP, do a quick reconnect, assert only one emission of that token. Put in sampleapp CI and mark as flaky-tolerant.

Priya Choudhury: opened draft PRs: sampleapp/sse-reconnect-fix (WIP) and platform/router header-normalize PR. CI triggered.

ci-bot: build 4092 started for sampleapp/sse-reconnect-fix.

Dan L: i'll add a tiny unit test for the Go parser that simulates mid-chunk EOF + reconnect to ensure we don't double-flush.

kevin: also audit X-Resume-Token and X-Request-Id usage across sdks to avoid other casing gaps.

Sasha: thanks, folks. Can we also add a short note in the SDK changelog about canonical header behavior so mobile integrators know to upgrade? :memo:
